Hi team —

HeliumOps asked for a single review to cover dedicated sizing, forecasted usage across Q3, and packaging/pricing options. They want procurement + security on the call so we can close the purchase path faster.

Quick ask: can we lock a 60-min window next week with the following attendees: AE (Aditya), SE (Dev), Security (Vivek), Procurement (Tara), and their engineering lead (Bryan)? I proposed three slots below (PDT):
- Tue 6/15 09:00–10:00
- Wed 6/16 11:00–12:00
- Thu 6/17 14:00–15:00

If any of these are a hard no, reply with availability and we’ll pivot. I’ll curate an agenda (pricing tiers, dedicated sizing assumptions, procurement timeline, and next steps) once we pick a slot.

Attachments: usage_forecast_v2.csv (Aditya attached a CSV with their reported token volumes).

Thanks,

- 10–25m: HeliumOps usage overview (Bryan)
- 25–45m: Redwood dedicated sizing & packaging options (Dev + Irene)
- 45–55m: Procurement path & PO questions (Tara)
- 55–60m: Next steps / owners (Lauren)

I’ll create the calendar invite and include a short pre-read: the dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (SE checklist) and our pricing matrix. Dev — I uploaded a draft template to the folder linked below; if you can attach the final sizing slide before EOD Tue that would be ideal.

Subject: Re: Request: coordinate Q3 dedicated sizing & packaging review

Irene / team —

Thanks — putting the sizing slide together now. A few notes so we’re aligned before the call:
- Please confirm whether the usage_forecast_v2.csv contains peak 95th-percentile token rate or average tokens/day. I assumed 95th pct for headroom.
- For back-of-envelope dedicated sizing I used: baseline 8x A100 equivalent for the reported 95th (details in attached dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx).
- We recommend enabling prefix caching for chat endpoints and a 30% burst buffer for Q3 launch.

I attached dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (SE checklist + math). I’ll post the final slides to the Drive folder by EOD. If procurement wants a draft PO language, I can paste a sample clause in the meeting notes.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
